inventory.visualPurpose: Antibody structure — the Y-shaped IgG anatomy diagram
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: A vector-drawn Y-shaped IgG: two Fab arms each with hypervariable V domains (VH, VL) at the tips (Antigen-binding site, Epitope labels) above constant domains (CH1, CL); a Hinge region with SS (disulfide) bonds; an Fc stem of heavy-chain-only CH2 and CH3 domains with Complement binding and Macrophage binding pointers; legend C = Constant, V = Variable, L = Light, H = Heavy, SS = Disulfide bond.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: Antibody function trio — neutralization / opsonization / complement activation
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Three function illustrations with captions: Neutralization (antibody prevents bacterial adherence); Opsonization (antibody promotes phagocytosis by marking pathogens for destruction, C3b); Complement activation (antibody activates complement, enhancing opsonization and lysis — membrane attack complex [MAC]). The 467x329 cmyk raster on the page belongs to this function set.
